# Every target reaches real LEDGERS and runs real HEADS prolog in a fresh JVM.
# Each non-tablature staff invokes actual processStaff(staff,true) in production
# order, then appends returned heads to systemCompetitors and stably ordinate-sorts.
# Range lookup, aggregation, duplicate/overlap purge, and linking never run.
#
# Internally, one headseedattempt row records every seed/side/original-shape loop
# iteration. The default runner omits these diagnostic rows after hashing them;
# pass --full-trace to retain them in generated output.
# Private eval/createInter are replayed against identical live state solely to expose
# provenance; their debug counters are restored before the production invocation and
# asserted equal afterward. Glyph outcome is predicted by the exact foreground gate.
# Compact headseedcandidate rows retain every minimum-grade provisional head, while
# Final rows freeze SIG/competitor identity order, inter impacts, registered glyph runs,
# and both identity-keyed HeadSeedTally dx values.
#
# Doubles are Double.toHexString/raw-bits. Run and row digests are FNV-1a-64 over
# canonical UTF-8 records with trailing newlines.
#
